newsitem.title: USA: Cost Plus Aug same-store sales up 4.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cost Plus Aug same-store sales up 4.4 pct.

text.p: Cost Plus Inc on Thursday said its same-store sales for the four weeks ended August 31 increased 4.4 percent from the same period in 1995.
Year-to-date, same-store sales for the 30 weeks ended August 31 increased 4.7 percent, the company said.
Total sales for the four-week period were $13.1 million, a 22.4 percent increase from $10.7 million for the four weeks ended September 2, 1995.
Year-to-date, total sales for the 30-week period were $92.2 million, a 20.2 percent increase from $76.7 million for the 30-week period ended September 2, 1995.
As of August 31, the company operated 53 stores, compared with 45 as of September 2, 1995.
Cost Plus, a retailer of casual home living and entertaining products, operates stores in 10 states.
